_readme: Seed traveler histories and abandoned carts for the Windfall recovery demo.
Synthetic by choice, for the two reasons in paper section 3.2.3: real booking
records are personally identifiable, and the penyisihan rules require static
parameters. Distribution shape is calibrated against Hotel Booking Demand
WHAT IS NOT IN HERE: prices. No cart total, no rung price, no saving. Those
come from live Duffel and hotel re-query at request time, because paper
section 3.1 promises bookable prices rather than a simulation. That is also
why no outcome is stored on a traveler -- the outcome is computed, and a
seed that pre-assigned it would make the demo a slideshow.
calibration_target is a seed-DESIGN goal, not a pipeline input. Nothing reads
it at runtime. It records which path each traveler was constructed to
exercise so that calibrate_seed.py can check live prices actually produce it,
and fail loudly when they do not.

travelers.name: Prasetyo Wibowo
travelers.calibrationNote: Premium, low campaign share. Pays full fare. The gate must close on the campaign-share axis even when the cart runs slightly over usual spend.

travelers.name: Ayu Kartika
travelers.calibrationNote: Premium, HIGH campaign share -- the contrast against wf-01. Same tier, opposite outcome, purely because campaign share differs. Hotel must be a large enough share of the cart that one star down genuinely clears tau=15%; verify against live prices, never back-fit.

travelers.name: Bagus Hartono
travelers.calibrationNote: Comfort tier, tau=10%. A same-star property in the same area must clear on rung 02, so the ladder stops before any downgrade is proposed. This is the outcome the product is least apologetic about.

travelers.name: Intan Maharani
travelers.calibrationNote: Value tier, tau=5%. Gate opens, but no rung clears -- thin inventory on the route means even a star down saves little. Falls through to a different trip within the same budget.

travelers.name: Rizky Firmansyah
travelers.calibrationNote: One booking, so campaign share is unmeasurable and MUST stay null -- a fabricated share here would fake the price-sensitivity signal outright. Tier comes from cart signals (paper section 3.2.5). The ladder still runs, because a rebuild concedes no margin.

travelers.name: Dewi Anggraini
travelers.calibrationNote: Exercises the upstream-failure path. Not in the paper; a pipeline over live carrier inventory will fail sometimes and a demo that cannot show it is dishonest. Needs one sentence added to the paper.
